استنكرن (form X)
# اِسْتَنْكَرْنَ (istankarna) /is.tan.kar.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِسْتَنْكَرَ (istankara)
# اُسْتُنْكِرْنَ (ustunkirna) /us.tun.kir.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِسْتَنْكَرَ (istankara)
# اِسْتَنْكِرْنَ (istankirna) /is.tan.kir.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِسْتَنْكَرَ (istankara)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
